title: Contrast Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/contrast_audit.mjs — a set of foreground/background color pairs and any semantic signals conveyed by color, to be checked against WCAG 2.x contrast minimums.

name.description: Human-readable label for this color pair, e.g. "hero-tagline" or "primary-button-border".

usage.description: body-text requires 4.5:1; large-text and ui-component require 3:1; decorative is exempt.

semanticSignals.description: Optional: pieces of meaning (error/success/required/etc.) and whether they rely on color alone.

name.description: Human-readable label for the signal, e.g. "form-error-state".

conveyedByColorOnly.description: True if this signal has no icon/text/pattern backup and relies solely on color to be understood (WCAG 1.4.1).
